setting.help: What regeneration does to a generated bill of materials that already exists. Odoo freezes a manufacturing order's components when it is confirmed, so neither choice can change an order that is already under way; this is about how much of the history you want to keep.
setting.div: Overwrite keeps a single bill of materials per configuration and rewrites it in place. Nothing accumulates, but the components a past quotation was costed from are lost.
Create a new revision leaves the existing bill of materials untouched, builds a replacement and archives the original. Every version that was ever quoted or built from stays readable.
